# CANDIDATE: VIX_RSI_DIVERGENCE_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When VIX makes a higher high while SPY RSI(14) makes a lower high, underlying bullish momentum is weakening despite rising fear, favoring a short. This divergence indicates that fear (VIX) is increasing but the underlying asset (SPY) is losing upward momentum, suggesting a potential short opportunity.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: If VIX > VIX[1] (higher than prior bar) and RSI(14) < RSI(14)[1] (lower than prior bar) and close < VWAP and close < 21 EMA, enter short at the close of that bar.
Exit shape: chart-stop at recent swing high (prior HH), TP1 at 2.0R, runner trail using structure stop at new LH.
